name: boomerang-flow-server
description: Boomerang Flow SSR server - wraps the react-router build (build/server) with Express and serves the browser assets (build/client). Replaces the old static-file @boomerang-io/webapp-spa-server, which has nothing to serve now that SSR is on (react-router.config.ts: ssr: true) and the frontend build no longer emits an index.html.
